segs.en: H. The Sabrosso Cleaner

zh.ai: H. Sabrosso 清洁工

segs.en: Pache is in a bad mood and ordered Dilon, el Sabrosso, to clean the training area. The area is a straight hallway, which we see as a number line. Dilon starts sweeping at position $$$0$$$ and moves to the right at a constant speed of one unit per second.

zh.ai: Pache心情不好，命令Dilon(el Sabrosso)打扫训练场地。该场地是一条直走廊，我们将其视为数轴。Dilon从位置 $$$0$$$ 开始清扫，并以每秒一个单位的恒定速度向右移动。

segs.en: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b154649749d83382498481258632dff4e576cc7b.png)

zh.ai: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b154649749d83382498481258632dff4e576cc7b.png)

segs.en: Pache watches $$$N$$$ points of the hallway. Point $$$i$$$ is at position $$$x_i$$$. At each point, Pache is angry or calm: at the beginning he is angry if $$$s_i = 1$$$ and calm if $$$s_i = 0$$$.

zh.ai: Pache 观察走廊上的 $$$N$$$ 个点。点 $$$i$$$ 位于位置 $$$x_i$$$。在每个点，Pache 要么愤怒，要么平静：初始时，若 $$$s_i = 1$$$，他就愤怒；若 $$$s_i = 0$$$，他就平静。

segs.en: Dilon starts at position $$$0$$$ and walks to the right. Every time he reaches a point, Pache's mood at that point decides what happens, and then that mood changes:

zh.ai: Dilon 从位置 $$$0$$$ 出发并向右行走。每当他到达一个点时，Pache 在该点的情绪会决定接下来发生什么，随后该情绪会发生变化：

segs.en: If Pache is angry, with his powers he instantly teleports Dilon to position $$$0$$$, and Dilon walks to the right again from there. Then Pache becomes calm at that point.

zh.ai: 如果 Pache 生气了，他就会立刻用自己的能力将 Dilon 传送到位置 $$$0$$$，然后 Dilon 从那里再次向右行走。此时 Pache 会恢复平静。

segs.en: If Pache is calm, Dilon keeps walking and Pache becomes angry at that point.

zh.ai: 如果 Pache 处于平静状态，Dilon 会继续行走，而 Pache 会在此时变得愤怒。

segs.en: Dilon finishes cleaning when he reaches position $$$x_N + 1$$$. How many seconds does it take him to get there? Since the answer can be huge, print it modulo $$$998\,244\,353$$$.

zh.ai: Dilon 到达位置 $$$x_N + 1$$$ 时完成清扫。他需要多少秒才能到达那里？由于答案可能很大，请输出答案对 $$$998\,244\,353$$$ 取模的结果。

segs.en: It can be shown that Dilon always finishes.

zh.ai: 可以证明，Dilon 总会完成。

segs.en: The first line contains an integer $$$N$$$, the number of points.

zh.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$N$$$，表示点的数量。

segs.en: Each of the following $$$N$$$ lines contains two integers $$$x_i$$$ and $$$s_i$$$: the position of point $$$i$$$ and Pache's initial mood at that point.

zh.ai: 以下 $$$N$$$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $$$x_i$$$ 和 $$$s_i$$$：分别表示点 $$$i$$$ 的位置以及 Pache 在该点的初始心情。

segs.en: Constraints

zh.ai: 约束条件

segs.en: $$$1 \le x_1  \lt  x_2  \lt  \dots  \lt  x_N \le 10^9$$$

zh.ai: $$$1 \le x_1  \lt  x_2  \lt  \dots  \lt  x_N \le 10^9$$$

segs.en: Print one integer: the time, in seconds, it takes Dilon to reach position $$$x_N + 1$$$, modulo $$$998\,244\,353$$$.

zh.ai: 输出一个整数：Dilon 到达位置 $$$x_N + 1$$$ 所需的时间(单位为秒)，对 $$$998\,244\,353$$$ 取模。

segs.en: Example 1. In the first example, Dilon passes $$$3$$$ at second $$$3$$$ (Pache becomes angry there) and reaches $$$6$$$ at second $$$6$$$, where Pache is angry and sends him back to $$$0$$$. At second $$$9$$$ he reaches $$$3$$$ again, where Pache is now angry, and goes back to $$$0$$$. Then he passes $$$3$$$ (second $$$12$$$), $$$6$$$ (second $$$15$$$) and $$$7$$$ (second $$$16$$$), leaving Pache angry at all three, and at second $$$17$$$ point $$$8$$$ sends him back to $$$0$$$. From there he still has seven more rounds before finally reaching position $$$9$$$ at second $$$57$$$.

zh.ai: 例 1。在第一个示例中，Dilon 在第 $$$3$$$ 秒经过 $$$3$$$(Pache 在那里变得愤怒)，并在第 $$$6$$$ 秒到达 $$$6$$$，此时 Pache 正在生气，于是把他送回 $$$0$$$。在第 $$$9$$$ 秒，他再次到达 $$$3$$$，此时 Pache 也在生气，于是他返回 $$$0$$$。接着，他经过 $$$3$$$(第 $$$12$$$ 秒)、$$$6$$$(第 $$$15$$$ 秒)和 $$$7$$$(第 $$$16$$$ 秒)，这三处都让 Pache 保持愤怒。到了第 $$$17$$$ 秒，$$$8$$$ 又把他送回 $$$0$$$。从那里开始，他还要再经过七轮，最终在第 $$$57$$$ 秒到达位置 $$$9$$$。

segs.en: Example 2. In the second example Pache starts calm at every point, so Dilon never starts over and reaches position $$$10$$$ at second $$$10$$$.

zh.ai: 示例 2。在第二个示例中，Pache 在每个点都以平静状态开始，因此 Dilon 从未重新开始，并在第 $$$10$$$ 秒到达位置 $$$10$$$。

segs.en: F. Four Warning

zh.ai: F. 四次警告

segs.en: Cindy's slick shuffling and fancy flourishes have allowed her to successfully sideline as a freelance card dealer. She's going to need some extra assistance for today's client, though, as he is... extremely superstitious.

zh.ai: Cindy 娴熟的洗牌技巧和华丽的花式动作让她成功兼职成为一名自由扑克牌发牌员。不过今天这位客户需要她多费些心思，因为他……非常迷信。

segs.en: Cindy has been contacted by Fun-Day Master Franz Chua to assist in fortune-telling by use of some mystical numbered cards. Each mystical card contains a single digit from $$$0$$$ to $$$9$$$. For the fortune-telling, Cindy takes a deck that consists of some number of mystical cards, shuffles it well, and then deals all of its card out in a row, in one straight line. Then, we concatenate the digits from left to right to form a single non-negative integer (possibly with leading zeroes).

zh.ai: Cindy 受 Fun-Day Master Franz Chua 委托，使用一些神秘数字卡片协助占卜。每张神秘卡片上都印有一个从 $$$0$$$ 到 $$$9$$$ 的数字。占卜时，Cindy 拿出一副由若干张神秘卡片组成的牌，将它们充分洗匀，然后把所有卡片排成一行。接着，她从左到右连接这些数字，得到一个非负整数(可能有前导零)。

segs.en: If the resulting number is divisible by $$$4$$$, then Fun-Day Master Franz Chua predicts that the client will be cursed to live a boring life for the rest of their days. Otherwise, he predicts that the client will have a wonderful and exciting week!

zh.ai: 如果结果数能被 $$$4$$$ 整除，那么 Fun-Day Master Franz Chua 预言这位客户余生都将被诅咒，过着无聊的生活。否则，他预言这位客户将度过精彩而令人兴奋的一周！

segs.en: Of course, Fun-Day Master Franz Chua doesn't actually like handing out ill fortunes—it's bad for business! So, he calls a deck of mystical cards Four-Safe if it is absolutely impossible that the resulting number is divisible by $$$4$$$, no matter how the deck is shuffled and dealt.

zh.ai: 当然，欢乐日大师 Franz Chua 并不喜欢发放不吉利的命运——这会影响生意！因此，如果无论如何洗牌和发牌，最终得到的数字都不可能被 $$$4$$$ 整除，他就称这副神秘卡牌为 Four-Safe。

segs.en: In order to test that his hired dealer actually understands his fortune-telling process, Fun-Day Master Franz Chua will only hire Cindy if she can solve the following puzzle.

zh.ai: 为了测试他雇来的荷官是否真的理解他的占卜流程，Fun-Day Master Franz Chua 只有在 Cindy 能解出下面这道谜题时才会雇用她。

segs.en: There are $$$n$$$ chests in Fun-Day Master Franz Chua's studio, labeled from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$. Each chest contains some number of mystical cards.

zh.ai: Fun-Day Master Franz Chua 的工作室里有 $$$n$$$ 个宝箱，编号从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n$$$。每个宝箱中都装有若干张神秘卡牌。

segs.en: Cindy first selects $$$k$$$ of the chests. Then, using only the mystical cards in those chests, she must choose some of them to assemble a Four-Safe deck. Cindy doesn't have to use all the mystical cards in these chests. The goal is to make as large a Four-Safe deck as possible (i.e. one with the greatest number of mystical cards).

zh.ai: Cindy 首先选择 $$$k$$$ 个箱子。然后，她只能使用这些箱子中的神秘卡牌，选择其中一部分组建一副四安全牌组。Cindy 不必使用这些箱子中的所有神秘卡牌。目标是组建尽可能大的四安全牌组(即神秘卡牌数量最多的牌组)。

segs.en: What is the largest possible Four-Safe deck that can be constructed by this process?

zh.ai: 通过这个过程可以构造出的最大四安全牌组有多大？

segs.en: The first line of input contains two space-separated integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$.

zh.ai: 输入的第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $$$n$$$ 和 $$$k$$$。

segs.en: Then, $$$n$$$ lines of input follow, describing the contents of each chest. The $$$i$$$th chest is described by a string of digits $$$s_i$$$ on the $$$i$$$th line. Each digit of $$$s_i$$$ corresponds to a card in the $$$i$$$th chest with that digit written on it.

zh.ai: 接下来是 $$$n$$$ 行输入，描述每个箱子的内容。第 $$$i$$$ 个箱子的描述是第 $$$i$$$ 行上的一个数字字符串 $$$s_i$$$。 $$$s_i$$$ 中的每个数字都对应着第 $$$i$$$ 个箱子里的卡片，卡片上写着该数字。

segs.en: $$\begin{align*}  &\begin{array}{|l|} \hline \text{Constraints For All Subtasks} \\ \hline 1 \leq k \leq n \leq 2\times 10^5 \\ \text{Each chest contains at least $1$ card.} \\ \text{There are at most $10^6$ cards in total.} \\ \hline \end{array}\\  &\begin{array}{|c|c|l|} \hline \text{Subtask} & \text{Points} & \text{Constraints} \\ \hline 1 & \mathbf{20} & \text{There are at most $5$ cards in total.} \\ \hline 2 & \mathbf{23} & n \leq 10 \\ \hline 3 & \mathbf{17} & n \leq 15 \\ \hline 4 & \mathbf{19} & n \leq 2000 \\ \hline 5 & \mathbf{21} & \text{No further constraints.} \\ \hline \end{array}\\  \end{align*}$$

zh.ai: $$\begin{align*}  &\begin{array}{|l|} \hline \text{Constraints For All Subtasks} \\ \hline 1 \leq k \leq n \leq 2\times 10^5 \\ \text{Each chest contains at least $1$ card.} \\ \text{There are at most $10^6$ cards in total.} \\ \hline \end{array}\\  &\begin{array}{|c|c|l|} \hline \text{Subtask} & \text{Points} & \text{Constraints} \\ \hline 1 & \mathbf{20} & \text{There are at most $5$ cards in total.} \\ \hline 2 & \mathbf{23} & n \leq 10 \\ \hline 3 & \mathbf{17} & n \leq 15 \\ \hline 4 & \mathbf{19} & n \leq 2000 \\ \hline 5 & \mathbf{21} & \text{No further constraints.} \\ \hline \end{array}\\  \end{align*}$$

segs.en: First, output a line with $$$k$$$ distinct space-separated integers from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$, corresponding to the indices of the chests you selected.

zh.ai: 首先，输出一行包含 $$$k$$$ 个互不相同、以空格分隔的整数，范围为 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n$$$，分别对应你选择的宝箱编号。

segs.en: Let $$$m$$$ be the size of your Four-Safe deck. If $$$m = 0$$$, output the string empty. Otherwise, if $$$m  \gt  0$$$, output a line containing a string of $$$m$$$ digits, representing the Four-Safe deck that you built. It must be possible to construct this string using only digits from the strings of the chests you selected.

zh.ai: 设 $$$m$$$ 为你的 Four-Safe 牌组的大小。如果 $$$m = 0$$$，输出字符串 empty。否则，如果 $$$m  \gt  0$$$，输出一行由 $$$m$$$ 个数字组成的字符串，表示你构建的 Four-Safe 牌组。构造该字符串时，只能使用你选中的宝箱字符串中的数字。

segs.en: If there are multiple possible answers, any will be accepted, so long as $$$m$$$ is maximized.

zh.ai: 如果有多个可能的答案，只要 $$$m$$$ 最大化，任意一个都可以。

segs.en: The second sample I/O shows that we are always forced to select exactly $$$k$$$ chests, even if we don't use any of the cards from some (or all) of the chosen chests.

zh.ai: 第二组样例输入/输出表明，我们始终必须恰好选择 $$$k$$$ 个宝箱，即使我们没有使用所选某些(或全部)宝箱中的任何卡片。

segs.en: M. Mondriamorsolo

zh.ai: M. Mondriamorsolo

segs.en: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8d6e8a99fc5b559cfc850a448891602ed856c36e.png)

zh.ai: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8d6e8a99fc5b559cfc850a448891602ed856c36e.png)

segs.en: Bob's Mondrianansala artworks from last year were so popular that his art teacher has tasked him with creating another collection of paintings for this year's STEM Exhibit. Bob, foolishly, accepts.

zh.ai: Bob 去年创作的蒙德里安风格作品大受欢迎，因此他的美术老师委托他为今年的 STEM 展览再创作一系列画作。Bob 不假思索地答应了。

segs.en: Bob's paintings will once again be composed entirely of rectangles, in what he calls the Mondriamorsolo style. This year, Bob wants his paintings to be even more gorgeously geometric, so he recalls the following definitions from math class.

zh.ai: Bob 的画作将再次完全由矩形构成，他称这种风格为 Mondriamorsolo 风格。今年，Bob 希望自己的画作更加华丽且富有几何感，因此他回想起数学课上的如下定义。

segs.en: Recall that two objects are congruent if one can be transformed into the other by some combination of rotations or reflections. Two objects are similar if one can be made congruent to the other by scaling it up or down by the same amount in all directions.

zh.ai: 请回忆，如果两个物体可以通过旋转或翻折的组合变换相互得到，那么它们是全等的。如果一个物体可以通过在所有方向上按相同倍数放大或缩小，从而与另一个物体全等，那么这两个物体是相似的。

segs.en: For example, consider the following image.

zh.ai: 例如，请看下面这张图片。

segs.en: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4ae42338ab2ba6526310f49bc94258ba4def40b7.png)

zh.ai: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4ae42338ab2ba6526310f49bc94258ba4def40b7.png)

segs.en: The $$$4 \times 6$$$ rectangle would be congruent to any other $$$4 \times 6$$$ rectangle.

zh.ai: $$$4 \times 6$$$ 矩形与任何其他 $$$4 \times 6$$$ 矩形都全等。

segs.en: The $$$4 \times 6$$$ and $$$6 \times 4$$$ rectangles are congruent because one is just a rotation of the other.

zh.ai: $$$4 \times 6$$$ 和 $$$6 \times 4$$$ 矩形全等，因为其中一个只是另一个旋转得到的。

segs.en: The $$$2 \times 3$$$ rectangle is similar to the $$$4 \times 6$$$ and $$$6 \times 4$$$ rectangles, because it can be made congruent to both of them by scaling by a factor of $$$2$$$ in all directions.

zh.ai: $$$2 \times 3$$$ 矩形与 $$$4 \times 6$$$ 和 $$$6 \times 4$$$ 矩形相似，因为沿所有方向按 $$$2$$$ 的比例缩放后，它可以分别与这两个矩形全等。

segs.en: Bob wants all rectangles in his painting to be irreducible, which he defines as follows:

zh.ai: Bob 希望他画中的所有矩形都是不可约的，他对不可约的定义如下：

segs.en: A rectangle is reducible if it has integer side lengths, and if it can be cut up into some number of non-overlapping rectangles that satisfy the following conditions,   They all also have integer side lengths

zh.ai: 如果一个矩形的边长均为整数，并且可以将其切割成若干个互不重叠的矩形，且这些矩形满足以下条件，则称该矩形是可约的：它们的边长也均为整数。

segs.en: They are all congruent to each other

zh.ai: 它们彼此都同余。

segs.en: They are all similar to the original rectangle

zh.ai: 它们都与原矩形相似。

segs.en: If not, then the rectangle is irreducible.

zh.ai: 如果不是，那么这个矩形就是不可约的。

segs.en: For example, the $$$4 \times 6$$$ rectangle is reducible, because we can cut it up into four $$$2 \times 3$$$ rectangles. On the other hand, we can show that the $$$2 \times 3$$$ rectangle is irreducible.

zh.ai: 例如，$$$4 \times 6$$$ 矩形是可约的，因为我们可以将它切分成四个 $$$2 \times 3$$$ 矩形。另一方面，我们可以证明 $$$2 \times 3$$$ 矩形是不可约的。

segs.en: Now, the problem. A painting is in the Mondriamorsolo style if it satisfies all of the following criteria.

zh.ai: 现在，来看这道题。如果一幅画满足以下所有条件，那么它就属于 Mondriamorsolo 风格。

segs.en: It is painted on an $$$n \times n$$$ canvas.

zh.ai: 它被绘制在一块 $$$n \times n$$$ 画布上。

segs.en: The painting is entirely composed of exactly $$$n$$$ rectangles with positive integer dimensions, and all of these rectangles are irreducible

zh.ai: 这幅画完全由恰好 $$$n$$$ 个正整数边长的矩形组成，并且所有这些矩形都不可再分。

segs.en: No two rectangles in the painting are congruent to each other.

zh.ai: 画中的任意两个矩形都不全等。

segs.en: Each rectangle is painted one of $$$26$$$ different colors, and the entire rectangle is painted that color.

zh.ai: 每个矩形都被涂成 $$$26$$$ 种颜色中的一种，且整个矩形都被涂成该颜色。

segs.en: No two rectangles that touch at their edges may have the same color (though rectangles of the same color may touch at corners).

zh.ai: 任意两个有公共边界线段的矩形都不能具有相同的颜色（但颜色相同的矩形可以仅在顶点处接触）。

segs.en: Here is an example of a $$$7 \times 7$$$ Mondriamorsolo painting.

zh.ai: 这是一幅 $$$7 \times 7$$$ Mondriamorsolo 画作的示例。

segs.en: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/311ebbb2a28816e575d2360bb6f6e2440ce6ecb3.png)

zh.ai: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/311ebbb2a28816e575d2360bb6f6e2440ce6ecb3.png)

segs.en: Given a positive integer $$$n$$$, help Bob by producing any painting of that size in the Mondriamorsolo style, or say that no such painting exists.

zh.ai: 给定一个正整数 $$$n$$$，请帮助 Bob 创作一幅符合 Mondriamorsolo 风格且大小为该数的画作，或者判断这样的画作不存在。

segs.en: Input consists of a single line that contains a single integer $$$n$$$.

zh.ai: 输入仅一行，包含一个整数 $$$n$$$。

segs.en: $$\begin{align*}  &\begin{array}{|l|} \hline \text{Constraints For All Subtasks} \\ \hline 1 \leq n \leq 1200 \\ \hline \end{array}\\  &\begin{array}{|c|c|l|} \hline \text{Subtask} & \text{Points} & \text{Constraints} \\ \hline 1 & \mathbf{30} & 1 \leq n \leq 8 \\ \hline 2 & \mathbf{16} & \text{$n=1$ or $n = 1000$} \\ \hline 3 & \mathbf{16} & \text{$n=1$ or $n = 1011$} \\ \hline 4 & \mathbf{16} & \text{$n=1$ or $n = 1200$} \\ \hline 5 & \mathbf{11} & 1 \leq n \leq 100 \\ \hline 6 & \mathbf{11} & \text{No further constraints.} \\ \hline \end{array}\\  \end{align*}$$

zh.ai: $$\begin{align*}  &\begin{array}{|l|} \hline \text{Constraints For All Subtasks} \\ \hline 1 \leq n \leq 1200 \\ \hline \end{array}\\  &\begin{array}{|c|c|l|} \hline \text{Subtask} & \text{Points} & \text{Constraints} \\ \hline 1 & \mathbf{30} & 1 \leq n \leq 8 \\ \hline 2 & \mathbf{16} & \text{$n=1$ or $n = 1000$} \\ \hline 3 & \mathbf{16} & \text{$n=1$ or $n = 1011$} \\ \hline 4 & \mathbf{16} & \text{$n=1$ or $n = 1200$} \\ \hline 5 & \mathbf{11} & 1 \leq n \leq 100 \\ \hline 6 & \mathbf{11} & \text{No further constraints.} \\ \hline \end{array}\\  \end{align*}$$

segs.en: If the task is possible, output YES. Otherwise, output NO.

zh.ai: 如果任务可以完成，输出 YES。否则，输出 NO。

segs.en: If YES, also output the painting. We will treat the painting as a pixelmap and represent it as an ASCII grid.

zh.ai: 如果答案是 YES，还要输出这幅画。我们会将这幅画视为像素图，并用 ASCII 网格表示。

segs.en: Output $$$n$$$ lines, each containing a string with $$$n$$$ uppercase English letters, representing the painting. Two pixels are considered the same color if they are represented by the same letter. Contiguous regions of pixels of the same color correspond to the rectangles.

zh.ai: 输出 $$$n$$$ 行，每行包含一个由 $$$n$$$ 个大写英文字母组成的字符串，表示这幅画。若两个像素由相同的字母表示，则认为它们的颜色相同。同色像素构成的连通区域对应于矩形。
